scope: Read-only upstream issue/PR/release triage against Blent source, retained logs and current installed identities. No driver or display experiments.

search.selection: Titles and bodies screened; relevant issue bodies and selected comments compared with local code. Not an exhaustive historical issue audit.
search.limits: No exact phrase result is not proof that no related issue or comment exists.

host.loaded_evdi_evidence: journalctl -b -k: DRM initialization identifies 1.14.15 for evdi.0 and evdi.1
host.module_version_field: Absent in modinfo/sysfs; not evidence that the module is unloaded.
host.identity_limits: Current installed binary equals checkout binary. This is not a rebuild/source attestation and does not identify the historical process responsible for each warning. No evdi_helper process observed during this read.

latest_release.kernel_fix: PR590 reconnect without a new modeset
latest_release.version_limit: Kernel module and libevdi are separate components. Their differing version numbers alone do not prove incompatibility.

warning_analysis.mechanism: After 250 ms Blent clears its local pending flag and grabs. Kernel pending state is not cleared by that grab, so another request can be ignored with a warning. Normal ready delivery clears kernel pending state. Both warning conditions remain in 1.15.1.
warning_analysis.qualification: This source mechanism was already documented in T623. It explains a possible warning sequence, not the historical warning count, lost frames, a blackout or idle blinking. Permanent retries protect against a genuinely lost ready event. The existing mock does not model kernel pending state.
warning_analysis.next: Attribute helper request/event/grab timing including idle and DPMS-off cases; preserve lost-event/no-spin regressions and add kernel-state-aware regression coverage before any change. Do not remove retries or patch libevdi based only on log volume.

sources.title: Restore the painter pipeline when a reconnect arrives without a modeset
ternary logic typo introduced in evdi_prime_import_sg_table()

relevant_candidates.assessment: Strong architectural relevance; reconnect/import failure not reproduced locally. PR590 is merged and released in 1.15.1. The import-page typo was fixed in 1.14.16.

relevant_candidates.resolution_evidence_needed: Use an isolated compositor to test quick disconnect/reconnect without a new modeset and invalid/boundary import sizes against stock drivers; retain a permanent failing regression for any Blent fix.

evdi_painter: Access to scanout FB, vblank event, dirty rects racy
drm: implement hrtimer-based vblank for proper frame pacing
drm: extend hrtimer vblank pacing with update gating and max_fps

relevant_candidates.resolution_evidence_needed: First attribute T748. In a bounded single-output fixture measure commits, ready events, grabs and presentation, preserving T593/T599 policy and T382 exclusion. Do not apply unmerged driver patches.

sources.title: Xorg freezes when evdi module is loaded at runtime (modprobe while X is running)
evdi_device_add hangs and freezes the display

relevant_candidates.assessment: Relevant to runtime module/device addition under Xorg. Issue575 is closed after upstream advised loading pre-created devices before Xorg. It does not establish the cause of the distinct late-glamor assertion or idle blinking.
local_evidence: T700 reproduced its signature with EVDI absent
relevant_candidates.resolution_evidence_needed: Use isolated Xorg to test device-pool exhaustion and capacity growth; verify safe supported behavior or an explicit failure/reboot contract without touching active desktop devices.

sources.title: ADDFB2 accepts 32 bpp formats the planes don't support (e.g. AR30), so compositors can't fall back
DisplayLink shows no output on Fedora 45 beta (Mutter 51~rc)

relevant_candidates.assessment: Relevant to maintained Wayland configurations, not a match to current X11 session. Upstream reports 10-bit framebuffer creation accepted before atomic format rejection prevents compositor fallback.
local_evidence: host/evdi/capture.c:82-93 rejects formats other than XR24/AR24
Safe helper rejection cannot fix a compositor failing before capture starts.
relevant_candidates.resolution_evidence_needed: Inspect driver admission and reproduce on isolated Mutter51; verify fallback or explicit unsupported reporting before claiming compatibility. Keep permanent invalid-format tests.

sources.title: Cursor leftover when leaving the screen
modeset: Dirty the last cursor sprite on unassign

relevant_candidates.assessment: Mouse-cursor damage path is relevant. PR589 merged 2026-10-02, after latest release 1.15.1; no local ghost-cursor report or reproduction.
local_evidence: Blent uses automatic cursor composition; no evdi_enable_cursor_events call
host/evdi/capture.c:42-56 forwards damage to capture buffers
relevant_candidates.resolution_evidence_needed: Test cursor hiding/leaving a static virtual display; verify stock release/backport inclusion and permanent cursor-removal/damage regressions before a fix.

sources.title: Issue between evdi and Lunar Lake's xe: evdi: [W] evdi_gem_mmap:490 Don't allow imported objects to be mapped: owner: xe
Failed to map scanout buffer on Wayland: EVDI-owned DMA-BUF returns -EOPNOTSUPP from vmap

relevant_candidates.assessment: Issue554 contains the same imported-object mmap rejection class, initially xe and later i915; local owner is amdgpu. Issue591 instead reports a failed vmap for EVDI-owned DMA-BUF under virtio/Wayland. Matching a warning class does not establish failed frame capture.
local_evidence: 8 local imported-mmap warnings in retained Oct8-9 evidence
relevant_candidates.resolution_evidence_needed: Correlate each warning with subsequent capture success, actual grab errors and presented frames; distinguish mmap rejection from vmap failure and owners.

sources.title: Hard kernel freeze triggered by "Double connect" warning on USB reconnect (Fedora 43, kernel 6.18.x)

weaker_or_nonmatching_candidates.assessment: An upstream reporter correlates double-connect warnings and later freezes on Intel/NVIDIA; no causal proof or matching local signature. PR590 also documents benign repeated connects by DisplayLinkManager.
local_evidence: Blent has exclusive device leasing and connected-output rechecks.
weaker_or_nonmatching_candidates.resolution_evidence_needed: Escalate only with matched duplicate-connect/ownership evidence; a warning alone is insufficient.

sources.title: Fixes

weaker_or_nonmatching_candidates.assessment: Open USB-parent teardown patch concerns dynamically USB-parent-linked EVDI devices. Blent opens numbered virtual cards, not evdi_open_attached_to. It does not explain an Android tablet missing from USB/ADB enumeration.
local_evidence: T747 already tracks missing hub enumeration evidence.
weaker_or_nonmatching_candidates.resolution_evidence_needed: Reconsider only if Blent uses the affected USB-parent attachment path or a native trace demonstrates that path.
